gist: Sensei asks to move the budget review from Thursday to Friday 09:30 and Yuuka reschedules it and notes what to bring.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[user:sensei 08:05] Yuuka, can we move Thursday's budget review? I have a meeting at SCHALE that runs until 14:00.
[you 08:09] Thursday 14:00 is booked for the Seminar room. What time can you do instead?
[user:sensei 08:10] Friday morning, any time before 11:00.
[you 08:12] Friday 09:30. The room is free and the review takes forty minutes.
[user:sensei 08:13] Friday 09:30 works for me.
[you] I'll update the schedule and notify Noa. Please bring the transport receipts for the month.
[user:sensei 08:14] All of them, understood.
### chat:huddle:m8c3rt5yu1

[noa-ushio] I'll move the Robotics Club's visit into it.
[you] Good. Keep it to thirty minutes.
[noa-ushio 11:43] Thirty minutes. Anything else for the board?
[you] The new copier code. It's 4471 until the end of the month.

[momoi-saiba] [face=happy] Ten, got it!
